_about: Exactly two experiment cards. Wording is editable; the tool fills quotes from the cited feedback records, {placeholders} from the data (see baseline_metrics), prerequisite checks and the readiness status. Citations use {"session": "S05", "field": "observed_behavior | user_statements | researcher_inferences"}. Never add keyword search volumes or virality claims — the copy check rejects them.

cards.title: Store page that shows the before/after layout and states the LiDAR requirement
cards.owner: Growth PM, ASO (name to be assigned before launch)
cards.channel: App Store custom product page, served to ASA_Category search ads
cards.target_problem: In ASA_Category traffic, {qs_rate} of first opens reach a qualified scan and {refund_rate} of verified purchases were fully refunded. The store page has to set the device requirement and the free-then-paid split before install, and show the before/after result people respond to.

prerequisites.text: Given readiness flag: commercial delivery ready
No verified payment left undelivered at cutoff
No purchase stuck in pending at cutoff
Custom product page analytics (impressions, installs) available in App Store Connect
Screenshot is a real in-app before/after render, not a mock-up

cards.hypothesis: If the ASA_Category custom product page leads with a real before/after layout and states the iPhone Pro (LiDAR) requirement in the first screenshot, then more of the people who install will reach a qualified scan, because they self-select on device and understand the free-then-paid value before installing.

copy.subtitle: See a better desk and bed layout
copy.screenshot_caption: Your room, rearranged — before you move anything
copy.footnote: First suggestion free · full guide is a paid upgrade

keyword_intent_groups.intent: Fix a work-from-home desk that feels draining
Rearrange a bedroom without buying furniture
Feng shui with a practical, non-mystical explanation

screenshot_concept.frame: Screenshot 1 of the custom product page
screenshot_concept.visual: Split view of one real scan: the current layout on the left, the green ghosted 'after' position of the desk on the right
screenshot_concept.caption: Your room, rearranged — before you move anything
screenshot_concept.footnote: First suggestion free · full guide is a paid upgrade

product_facts.text: A free first suggestion is shown before any payment
The app shows a before/after ghosted preview of the new layout
Users can re-scan after a change and see the score move

unsupported_capabilities.text: Direct shopping links for recommended furniture

marketing_hypotheses: A visible before/after on the store page raises install intent the way the in-app preview raised purchase intent for one participant.
Stating the LiDAR requirement up front may lower installs but raise the share of installs that reach a qualified scan.
Saying 'first suggestion free, full guide paid' before install reduces refunds caused by mismatched expectations.

baseline_metrics.label: Verified first-time payer ÷ free suggestion viewed
First opens the budget buys at the observed cost

primary_metric.name: Qualified scans per product page impression
primary_metric.numerator: First opens from the custom product page that reach a qualified scan (event log)
primary_metric.denominator: Custom product page impressions (App Store Connect). Store impressions only — no video plays.
primary_metric.baseline: Not in the input data: measure the default page over the same 14 days as the control.

guardrails.name: Refund share
guardrails.denominator: Verified purchases from the page cohort

guardrails.name: Cash cost per qualified scan
guardrails.denominator: Qualified scans from the page cohort

cards.stop_rule: Stop when the {budget_cap} cap is spent or after 14 days. Stop early if any verified payment from this cohort stays undelivered for more than 24 hours, or if the refund share rises above {refund_rate}. If fewer than 20 first opens are reached (budget reach: {reach}), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.
cards.continue_rule: Roll the page out to all ASA traffic only if, with at least 20 first opens, qualified scans per impression beat the default page over the same period, qualified scan ÷ first open is at or above {qs_rate}, and no guardrail is breached.

cards.title: 3-shot 'desk facing the door' fix with a KOC creator
cards.owner: Content lead, KOC program (name to be assigned before launch)
cards.channel: TikTok, existing KOC creators (TikTok_KOC), one tracking link per video
cards.target_problem: In TikTok_KOC traffic, {qs_rate} of first opens reach a qualified scan and {refund_rate} of verified purchases were fully refunded. Content should attract people with a concrete desk problem and a LiDAR iPhone, and set the free-then-paid expectation.

prerequisites.text: Given readiness flag: commercial delivery ready
No verified payment left undelivered at cutoff
No purchase stuck in pending at cutoff
Creator brief approved; creator shows the real app screen, no staged results
One tracking link per video so first opens can be attributed

cards.hypothesis: If KOC videos show one concrete desk-facing-the-door fix with the real before/after preview and say the app needs an iPhone Pro, then TikTok_KOC first opens will reach a qualified scan more often than the current baseline ({qs_rate}), because the video pre-qualifies people on problem and device.

copy.hook: Your desk is facing the door. Here's the 10-second fix.

script.on_screen_text: Real scan · iPhone Pro with LiDAR
script.voiceover: I scanned the room and it showed me where the desk should go, without buying anything.

script.visual: Desk moved; creator re-scans and the app's real score change is shown on screen (no number promised in advance)
script.on_screen_text: First suggestion free · full guide paid
script.voiceover: Moved it, re-scanned, and my score went up. Try the free suggestion first.

product_facts.text: A free first suggestion is shown before any payment
The app shows a before/after ghosted preview of the new layout
Users can re-scan after a change and see the score move

unsupported_capabilities.text: A guaranteed score increase (one participant reported +20; it is not a promise)

marketing_hypotheses: A specific desk problem attracts higher-intent viewers than general feng shui content.
Saying 'needs iPhone Pro' in the video reduces installs that cannot scan.
Showing the real re-test score change makes the video worth saving; reach is not assumed or promised.

baseline_metrics.label: First opens the budget buys at the observed cost

primary_metric.name: Qualified scan rate
primary_metric.numerator: First opens from the video tracking links that reach a qualified scan (event log)
primary_metric.denominator: First opens from those links (event log). Video views are never used as this denominator.

guardrails.name: Refund share
guardrails.denominator: Verified purchases from the tracked links

guardrails.name: Cash cost per qualified scan
guardrails.denominator: Qualified scans from the tracked links

guardrails.name: Content diagnostic (separate funnel)
guardrails.denominator: Video impressions → 3-second views → link clicks, from TikTok analytics
guardrails.rule: Reported on its own; never mixed into app-funnel denominators

cards.stop_rule: Stop when the {budget_cap} cap is spent or after 14 days. Pause a creator's video if its cohort's refund share rises above {refund_rate}. If fewer than 20 tracked first opens are reached (budget reach: {reach}), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.
cards.continue_rule: Brief new creators with the same script only if, with at least 20 tracked first opens, qualified scan ÷ first open is above {qs_rate}, cash cost per qualified scan is at or below {cash_per_scan}, and no guardrail is breached.
